tools.name: list_ad_options
tools.description: List what the meme engine can produce for ads: supported languages, creative formats (with list credit cost; BYOK keys pay $0.01 per MCP call) and brand voices. Call this first. Pass the chosen format id as `format` (generate_ad_creative, generate_multilanguage_ads) or in `creatives` (shop).

tools.name: generate_ad_creative
tools.description: One ad creative in one language, in the format you pass as `format` (iMessage / text-message thread → "hybrid"; carousel / slideshow / multi-slide → "carousel"; hot take / opinion → "hottake"; confession → "confession"; single meme / static image → "image"; omitted = single meme). Returns a TEMP PAGE preview (not an MP4), PNG URLs (adAssets, media_url), post_copy and a referralUrl. Costs the format's list credits (see list_ad_options); BYOK: $0.01.

brief.description: What the ad is about: product, hook, angle.

format.description: Creative format — set it to what was asked; omitted = single meme. iMessage / text-message thread → "hybrid"; carousel / slideshow / multi-slide → "carousel"; hot take / opinion → "hottake"; confession → "confession"; single meme / static image → "image".

offer.description: Offer or call to action to work into the creative.

includeAssets.description: Render PNGs and return URLs (default true, free).

sizes.description: PNG sizes (default all). Not the creative `format`.

allFrames.description: Export every slide (max 10). Default true for carousel/hybrid.

brand.description: Brand key from list_ad_options (default house brand).

brandProfile.description: Ad-hoc brand voice, overrides `brand`: name, voice (≤1000), hashtag, token, ctaStyle {tone, action (no URL), linkPlacement first-comment|caption, avoid[], examples[]}.

tools.name: generate_multilanguage_ads
tools.description: Generate the SAME ad concept in several languages at once (up to 6 per call, run in parallel), all in the one `format` you pass (iMessage / text-message thread → "hybrid"; carousel / slideshow / multi-slide → "carousel"; hot take / opinion → "hottake"; confession → "confession"; single meme / static image → "image"; omitted = single meme). Each language is generated natively, not machine-translated, and billed/refunded independently (the format's list credits per language; BYOK: $0.01 for the whole call). Returns one result per language; failures are reported per language.

format.description: Creative format — set it to what was asked; omitted = single meme. iMessage / text-message thread → "hybrid"; carousel / slideshow / multi-slide → "carousel"; hot take / opinion → "hottake"; confession → "confession"; single meme / static image → "image".

includeAssets.description: Render PNGs and return URLs (default true, free).

sizes.description: PNG sizes (default all). Not the creative `format`.

allFrames.description: Export every slide (max 10). Default true for carousel/hybrid.

brand.description: Brand key from list_ad_options (default house brand).

brandProfile.description: Ad-hoc brand voice, overrides `brand`: name, voice (≤1000), hashtag, token, ctaStyle {tone, action (no URL), linkPlacement first-comment|caption, avoid[], examples[]}.

tools.name: export_ad_assets
tools.description: Render ad-ready files from a page you already generated: PNGs at 1:1 (1080x1080), 4:5 (1080x1350) and 9:16 (1080x1920), optionally a 9:16 MP4 (+25 credits, same $0.25 as request_mp4; BYOK: $0.01 with your own Railway worker, else $0.25). The PNGs are free. Use the pageUrl returned by generate_ad_creative. Files are hosted ~24h — upload to the ad platform right away.

includeAssets.description: Render PNGs and return URLs (default true, free).

sizes.description: PNG sizes (default all). Not the creative `format`.

allFrames.description: Export every slide (max 10). Default true for carousel/hybrid.

tools.name: request_mp4
tools.description: AFTER a human has approved a preview, start rendering an MP4 of that temp page (25 credits = $0.25; BYOK: $0.01 with your own Railway worker saved, else the full $0.25; refunded on failure). Rendering takes 1–3 minutes. To avoid polling: pass callback_url (we POST the signed result when it finishes) and/or wait_seconds (hold this call open up to 100s and return the finished mp4Url inline; if it isn't done by then you still get the jobId for get_job_status (kind mp4)). Never render MP4s for unapproved previews.

pageUrl.description: The approved pageUrl from generate_ad_creative / generate_multilanguage_ads.

callback_url.description: Optional https webhook. Receives the signed done/failed result; the response carries the webhook secret once.

wait_seconds.description: Optional, 0-100. Wait this long for the MP4 and return it in the same call.

tools.name: create_funnel
tools.description: /funnel: ONE offer link becomes voiced content whose CTA is that link: captions (+ an iMessage thread; voiced typography page, no memes), memes (voiced page with memes + a picture or iMessage meme) or a stick-figure story; format bestof builds a silent day of content (2 memes, an iMessage, a slideshow, a top 10) AND publishes one share page bundling everything (dayPack.shareUrl); format share rebuilds that page. Reads the page (never invents; unreadable = status needs-description, then call with funnel_id + description). Omit format to analyze first; switch with funnel_id + format, no new link. 10 credits to read; captions 25, memes 35, stickfigures 25, bestof 60 (BYOK $0.01/call); refunded on failure. Poll get_job_status (kind funnel, jobId = funnelId). Previews only: show offer.url under them; no posting or MP4 without the human's OK.

url.description: The offer link, kept exactly (referral params untouched). Not needed with funnel_id.

funnel_id.description: Earlier funnelId: switch format, regenerate or describe without the link.

variation.description: same = regenerate, next = new angle (default same).

description.description: What the offer is and who it's for, when the page can't be read.

cta.description: Button label under the preview. Default: from the product name.

tools.name: create_one_minute
tools.description: The /1minute engine. Give it ONE of: a topic (the engine WRITES and VOICES a ~60s Uncomfortable Truth take), your own https mp3/m4a/wav (<=24MB — YOUR voice), or a link to extract audio from (YouTube clip, here.now page, direct mp3). It becomes a 9:16 captioned page on a temp page. 25 credits ($0.25, BYOK: $0.01, page only; the MP4 is a separate step), refunded on failure. Returns a jobId at once — poll get_job_status (kind one_minute). After the human approves, regen_one_minute for another look or request_mp4 for video.

topic.description: The take's topic (<=600 chars). Use this OR audio_url OR link.

audio_url.description: https link to your OWN mp3/m4a/wav (<=24MB). Use this OR topic OR link.

link.description: A page/clip URL (YouTube, here.now page, direct mp3) to extract audio from. Use this OR topic OR audio_url.

language.description: Language name or code, e.g. es, ja, Portuguese.

tools.name: create_video_pack
tools.description: The /video bundle in one call: from the user's recording (audio_url), a topic or a link, makes the voiced, captioned 9:16 /video page, then — from that take's own transcript — a meme slideshow, an iMessage page and a hot-take page. Each piece returns its temp page, PNG URLs (adAssets / media_url), post_copy and a referralUrl. Optional `languages` (max 3) adds a localized video per language. Cost: 65 credits ($0.65) base + 40 ($0.40) per language; BYOK: $0.01 for the whole call. Each piece is refunded on its own failure. Waits up to wait_seconds (max 100); if the take is not done by then it returns a jobId — call again with source_job_id (do NOT resend the audio; nothing more is charged).

audio_url.description: https link to the user's recorded audio (mp3/m4a/wav, <=24MB, <=3 min). Use this OR topic OR link OR source_job_id.

topic.description: A topic instead of audio (<=600 chars): the engine writes and voices the take.

link.description: A page/clip URL to extract audio from.

source_job_id.description: Resume: the jobId a previous call returned while the take was still rendering. No new take is created or charged.

language.description: Language of the source take (default: as spoken / English).

languages.description: Optional extra languages for the video, e.g. ["Spanish","Japanese"] (max 3, 40 credits each).

wait_seconds.description: How long to hold this call open (default 100, max 100).

includeAssets.description: Render PNGs and return URLs (default true, free).

sizes.description: PNG sizes (default all). Not the creative `format`.

allFrames.description: Export every slide (max 10). Default true for carousel/hybrid.

tools.name: localize_1minute
tools.description: One call from source to localized videos: makes a /1minute take from a topic, your OWN audio_url or a link (or reuses a done take's jobId, no new source), then localizes it into up to 4 languages in parallel (native rewrite + narrator voice + beat-timed 9:16 page). Per language it returns the temp page, PNG URLs (adAssets / media_url), post_copy and a referralUrl. Cost: 25 credits ($0.25) for the source + 40 ($0.40) per language (BYOK: $0.01 for the whole call), each refunded on its own failure. Waits up to wait_seconds (max 100); anything unfinished comes back with a jobId for get_job_status. For carousel, hot-take or iMessage ads in many languages use generate_multilanguage_ads.

topic.description: The take's topic (<=600 chars). Use this OR audio_url OR link.

audio_url.description: https link to your OWN mp3/m4a/wav (<=24MB). Use this OR topic OR link.

link.description: A page/clip URL to extract audio from. Use this OR topic OR audio_url.

jobId.description: A done /1minute take to localize instead (no new source is made or charged).

wait_seconds.description: How long to hold this call open for the whole pipeline (default 90, max 100).

includeAssets.description: Render PNGs and return URLs (default true, free).

sizes.description: PNG sizes (default all). Not the creative `format`.

allFrames.description: Export every slide (max 10). Default true for carousel/hybrid.

tools.name: publish_clip
tools.description: Publicly post a finished clip to X and/or Telegram with the poster's ?ref= tracking link attached. Only call this AFTER the human has approved this exact clip and caption for posting — it goes live at once and can't be undone from here. 10 credits ($0.10; BYOK: $0.01), refunded if every network refuses. X needs the key owner's Upload-Post connection (Telegram /connect once); Telegram posts via the bot API to chatId (default: the owner's chat; bot must be able to post there). The first https URL in the caption gets ?ref=<code>; with no URL the default landing carries it. Use the localize result's socialCopy.headline as the caption.

mp4Url.description: https link to the finished clip (the mp4Url from get_job_status, kind mp4).

caption.description: Post copy — e.g. the localize result's socialCopy.headline.

chatId.description: Telegram target chat/channel (optional; defaults to the owner's chat).

ref.description: Tracking code (optional; defaults to the poster's telegram id).

tools.name: chat_with_brand
tools.description: Talk to a branded bot (e.g. brand "joblessjoe" for Jobless Joe; keys from list_ad_options) in its own voice. Send the conversation so far as `messages` (you keep the history), or one `message`. Returns `reply`. 1 credit ($0.01; BYOK: $0.01).

message.description: The next thing the human says (use this or messages).

messages.description: Whole conversation so far, oldest first, ending with the user's turn. Last 12 are kept.

language.description: Reply in this language (default: whatever the human writes in).

brand.description: Brand key from list_ad_options (default house brand).

brandProfile.description: Ad-hoc brand voice, overrides `brand`: name, voice (≤1000), hashtag, token, ctaStyle {tone, action (no URL), linkPlacement first-comment|caption, avoid[], examples[]}.

tools.name: create_sitdown
tools.description: The /sitdown command: the stick-figure host at a talk-show desk, voiced on Fish Audio. Send ONE input: `topic` (the writer drafts it; add `guest` for an interview), `script` (spoken as written; "NAME:" lines are a guest), `links` (best-of reel), `clip` (plays first, the host answers it with a /phone demo), or audio you already have (`audioscript_job_id` / `audio_url` / `audio_base64`: laid out as-is, never re-voiced; a `script` sent with it becomes captions). 25 credits ($0.25; BYOK: $0.01), refunded on failure. Returns a jobId — poll get_job_status (kind sitdown), usually 1–2 min. Done carries pageUrl (a preview, no MP4): show it; call request_mp4 only after the human approves.

topic.description: Easiest: one line on what the segment is about (≤400 chars); the writer drafts it. Use this OR script OR links OR an audio source.

script.description: The words to speak, as written (≤6000 chars). Lines starting "NAME:" are a guest. With audio: its captions instead. Use this OR topic OR links OR an audio source.

links.description: 1–5 https links for a best-of reel: a temp page (/m/…) or a direct .mp4/.gif/.png. Use this OR topic/script/audio.

theme.description: With links: the theme the countdown hangs on, e.g. "job hunt fails" (≤120 chars).

guest.description: With topic: a guest name to make it an interview, e.g. "Sam".

clip.description: One https link, or up to 3: an mp3, an X / YouTube post, or a direct .mp4. The first plays full-frame with its own sound; the show then answers all of them. A bare clip link in `topic` counts too.

clip_seconds.description: Seconds of the first clip to play: 3–30, default 15.

scene.description: The set the host sits on (default: the owner's saved set).

outfit.description: Tie, or the show's tee (default: the brand's look).

accessory.description: 2–5 words on the host's shirt, e.g. "I LOVE GARY VEE" (≤40 chars). Implies outfit: tee.

joe.description: Host the show as Jobless Joe (his cast and look) instead of the key owner's saved host.

language.description: Language name, e.g. Spanish. Default English.

audioscript_job_id.description: A FINISHED create_audioscript job: reuse its take, never re-voiced (fastest).

audio_url.description: https link to a recording (mp3/m4a/wav, ≤24MB, ≤3 min), pre-flighted before charging.

audio_base64.description: Audio bytes base64-encoded. Only a short clip fits the 1 MiB /api/mcp limit — longer audio must be audio_url.

tools.name: create_phone_demo
tools.description: The /phone command: a ~60s sit-down where the posts (memes, a ranked list, a carousel) land on the host's phone. Send ONE input: `topic` (`shape` picks the cut), `script` (quoted words and [phone:meme] … [/phone] bits are what the phone shows), `clip`, or audio you already have (never re-voiced; a `script` sent with it is its captions). For a full sit-down with no phone bits use create_sitdown. 25 credits ($0.25; BYOK: $0.01), refunded on failure. Returns a jobId — poll get_job_status (kind sitdown), usually 1–2 min. Done carries pageUrl (a preview, no MP4): show it; call request_mp4 only after the human approves.

topic.description: Easiest: one line on what the video is about (≤400 chars), e.g. a product and who it's for. Use this OR script OR clip OR an audio source.

shape.description: With topic: mixed (default) = memes, a list or a carousel on the phone; ranked = a ranked list, read out. imessage is the retired one-thread cut and now runs as mixed.

script.description: Your own words instead of the writer's (≤6000 chars, 'NAME: line' for a guest). With audio: its captions instead.

clip.description: One https link, or up to 3: an mp3, an X / YouTube post, or a direct .mp4. The first plays full-frame with its own sound; the show then answers all of them. A bare clip link in `topic` counts too.

clip_seconds.description: Seconds of the first clip to play: 3–30, default 15.

scene.description: The set the host sits on (default: the owner's saved set).

outfit.description: Tie, or the show's tee (default: the brand's look).

accessory.description: 2–5 words on the host's shirt, e.g. "I LOVE GARY VEE" (≤40 chars). Implies outfit: tee.

language.description: Language name, e.g. Spanish. Default English.

audioscript_job_id.description: A FINISHED create_audioscript job: reuse its take, never re-voiced (fastest).

audio_url.description: https link to a recording (mp3/m4a/wav, ≤24MB, ≤3 min), pre-flighted before charging.

audio_base64.description: Audio bytes base64-encoded. Only a short clip fits the 1 MiB /api/mcp limit — longer audio must be audio_url.

tools.name: create_ridiculous
tools.description: The /ridiculous command: one ~30s episode of Jobless Joe's meme reaction show — Joe roasts the topic in five scenes while Ralph acts it out on a giant TV. `topic` is a subject, a link (roasted as a website autopsy), a business, or "roast my competitor's ad". Optional `format` forces a segment. 25 credits ($0.25; BYOK: $0.01), refunded on failure. Returns a jobId — poll get_job_status (kind sitdown), usually 1–2 min. Done carries pageUrl (a preview, no MP4): show it; call request_mp4 only after the human approves. Done also carries `format` and `altEnding`.

topic.description: What the episode roasts (≤400 chars): a topic, a link, a business, or e.g. "roast my competitor's ad".

format.description: Force a segment. Default: picked from the topic (a link is a website autopsy).

alt_ending.description: Use the episode's alternate last line instead of the main one.

tools.name: create_news
tools.description: Telegram /joenews (not /news). Live sources. Desk/tv, 45–120s. mode or topic; short|standard|deep; language. Refunds if none answer. 25 credits ($0.25; BYOK $0.01). Poll get_job_status (sitdown): pageUrl, caption, sources. One outlet is reported. MP4 after approval.

mode.description: Default general (top stories). Ignored with a topic.

layout.description: desk (default): Joe + Phony showing each story's picture; tv: the giant TV.

pages.description: ≤3 https pages that play on Joe's TV: temp /m/ page, .mp4/.gif/.png, here.now or plunderandriffle.com page.

audio_url.description: https mp3/wav/m4a that plays first; Joe reacts.

tools.name: create_best_of
tools.description: The /sitdown bestof command: 1–5 temp pages or direct media links play, silent, on the sidekick's screen while the host counts them down — one voiced best-of reel. Give `links` and an optional `theme`. 25 credits ($0.25; BYOK: $0.01), refunded on failure. Returns a jobId — poll get_job_status (kind sitdown), usually 1–2 min. Done carries pageUrl (a preview, no MP4): show it; call request_mp4 only after the human approves.

links.description: 1–5 https links: a temp page (/m/<id>) or a direct .mp4/.gif/.png. A whitespace-separated string works too.

theme.description: Optional theme the countdown hangs on, e.g. "job hunt fails" (≤120 chars).

scene.description: The set the host sits on (default: the owner's saved set).

outfit.description: Tie, or the show's tee (default: the brand's look).

accessory.description: 2–5 words on the host's shirt, e.g. "I LOVE GARY VEE" (≤40 chars). Implies outfit: tee.

language.description: Language name, e.g. Spanish. Default English.

tools.name: get_best_of
tools.description: The /bestof command: a best-of page of FIVE generations. Returns this key's best five pages from the last 22h (free). With fewer than five (or refresh: true) it creates them from `topic`: 2 memes, an iMessage, a slideshow, a top 10 (60 credits, $0.60; BYOK $0.05). Returns items and reelLinks for create_best_of. Show the pages; request_mp4 only after approval.

topic.description: What new pages are about. Needed when there are not five past pages, or with refresh.

refresh.description: Skip the past; create five new (spends credits).

tools.name: shop
tools.description: The /shop push pack: any product link or description → researched, ready-to-post copy (hooks, meme lines, iMessage thread, CTA, hashtags, first comment) plus up to 3 creatives (TEMP PAGE previews + PNGs + post_copy). 10 credits for the context + each format's list credits (list_ad_options); BYOK: $0.01. Each part refunded on its own failure. ~30–90s.

input.description: A product/page link, or a description of the product when there is no link (≤1500 chars).

creatives.description: Creative formats to build (max 3); omitted = one single meme, [] = copy only. iMessage / text-message thread → "hybrid"; carousel / slideshow / multi-slide → "carousel"; hot take / opinion → "hottake"; confession → "confession"; single meme / static image → "image".

includeAssets.description: Render PNGs and return URLs (default true, free).

sizes.description: PNG sizes (default all). Not the creative `format`.

allFrames.description: Export every slide (max 10). Default true for carousel/hybrid.

brand.description: Brand key from list_ad_options (default house brand).

brandProfile.description: Ad-hoc brand voice, overrides `brand`: name, voice (≤1000), hashtag, token, ctaStyle {tone, action (no URL), linkPlacement first-comment|caption, avoid[], examples[]}.

tools.name: create_before_pitch
tools.description: The /before pitch machine. Give it ONE person (their website, an x.com or linkedin link, or a sentence about them) and it builds a personalized pitch: a personal message, a meme, an iMessage thread and a voice-note script, on a phone page. Returns `pageUrl` (the full phone page) and `shareUrl` — a 24-hour, self-destructing share page that shows their message in a phone and has NO link back to us, so the human shares it alongside their OWN link. Costs 10 credits ($0.10; BYOK: $0.01; refunded on failure).

input.description: Website, x.com / linkedin link, or a sentence about the person (max 1500 chars).

language.description: Write and speak the pitch in this language (default English).

offer.description: What the sender is pitching (their service, offer…). Defaults to the Meme Engine.

tools.name: create_two_step
tools.description: Jobless Joe's two-step outreach, Step 1. Give it ONE prospect (X handle, post link, website, linkedin, or a line about them): it researches them and drafts a 30-second gift meme about THAT product or brand (script, text DM, caption, meme lines, evidence). Drafts only — nothing is sent; the human sends it. Won't write without real material about the prospect. Leave offer unset. Pass offer mercor only when the human explicitly asked for the Mercor data introduction. Pass offer 24hour (with price_usd) only for a 24-hour meme run. A prospect already in the queue returns its saved campaign for the SAME offer (redraft: true writes a new one); a skipped Mercor draft is not reused as the gift. A no or opt-out is refused. Costs 10 credits ($0.10; refunded on failure). Returns `id`: when the prospect replies, call continue_two_step. To film the script, pass `step1.script` to create_sitdown.

input.description: Handle, x.com post link, website, linkedin link, or a sentence about the prospect (max 1500 chars).

redraft.description: Write a new Step 1. Does not return the saved campaign.

offer.description: Default gift: a meme about their product. mercor or opportunity only when the human asked for the Mercor data intro. 24hour needs price_usd.

tools.name: continue_two_step
tools.description: Two-step outreach, Step 2. Pass the campaign `id` from create_two_step and what the prospect replied. Only a clear yes writes the two-minute breakdown (10 credits, refunded otherwise); a no is logged and an unclear reply holds it. Pass funnel: true on a yes to also run /funnel on THEIR page (read 10, show 25, day 60; poll get_job_status kind funnel with funnel.funnelId): a share page made from their own link plus an invite to /funnel with it prefilled. Call again with the same id (free) to get funnel.message, a draft to send. Drafts only — the human sends it.

reply.description: The prospect's reply, pasted as they wrote it.

funnel.description: On a yes: also build a /funnel share page from their own page.

funnel_url.description: Their offer page, when the campaign only has social links.

tools.name: find_leads
tools.description: Check up to 10 candidate prospects (handles, links, sites, or a line each) before create_two_step. Returns `leads` with real public material, and `skipped` with why (already_in_queue, declined, opted_out, ungrounded, duplicate). Never padded. Free.

tools.name: list_outreach_queue
tools.description: This key's outreach queue, one entry per prospect (status, campaignId), newest first. Shared with /2step on Telegram. Free.

tools.name: mark_outreach
tools.description: Record what the human did with a draft: sent, skipped, or opted_out (never contact again). Pass campaign_id, or `prospect` (handle/link/name) to opt someone out. Replies go to continue_two_step. Only `sent` when the human says so. Free.

tools.name: create_demo_pack
tools.description: A day of posts for ONE company in one call: 5 memes, an iMessage about one of their products, a Top 10 and a slideshow, made for their feed from what we read about them, plus one page with 4 phones playing them under a short video of Joe walking them through it (send that link). Pass a /2step campaign_id (reuses its research) or input (handle, site, post link). Async: poll get_job_status kind demo_pack. 115 credits ($1.15), failed pieces refunded. Drafts only.

product.description: Product for the iMessage (default: one from their site).

tools.name: create_followup
tools.description: The follow-up buttons over MCP: rebuild what a finished video ALREADY said as another post — same subject, same points, nothing new invented. Pass ONE source: `job_id` (a done sitdown/phone/best-of job from create_sitdown / create_phone_demo / create_best_of), `source_id` (the `id` a create_before_pitch returned), or `context` (the text to build on). `format` is the output: meme, slideshow, hottake (10 credits, $0.10; BYOK: $0.01) or imessage (20 credits, $0.20). Returns the new pageUrl directly (no polling); show it, and only after the human approves call request_mp4 with it. Refunded on failure.

job_id.description: A FINISHED sitdown or phone jobId — its own script becomes the material. Use this OR source_id OR context.

source_id.description: The `id` from create_before_pitch — the pitch is remembered for 2h. Use this OR job_id OR context.

context.description: Material to build from when there is no id: the script, the pitch text or the key points (≤4000 chars). Use this OR job_id OR source_id.

title.description: With context: what it is, e.g. "Pitch for Maria".

kind.description: With context: what the material came from (default note).

format.description: The post to build: meme (one image), slideshow, hottake or imessage (a narrated thread).

instruction.description: Optional one-line direction for THIS piece (e.g. "make it about the interview, not the layoff"), ≤300 chars.

language.description: With context: output language. A job/pitch keeps its own.

tools.name: get_bot_commands
tools.description: Read a brand bot's commands and their state (command-registry.ts): `on` = in the bot's "/" menu, `hidden` = works when typed but isn't listed, `off` = blocked. Each command also has `available` (false = the bot doesn't have that tool; setting it on does nothing) and `locked` (/help, /buy: always on). Free. The key must belong to one of the brand's admins or owners; otherwise the answer is "bot not found".

tools.name: set_bot_commands
tools.description: Set which commands a brand bot shows. Send only the ones you're changing in `states`, e.g. {"submit":"off","videos":"on"}: on / hidden / off. Saving refreshes the bot's Telegram menu. Unknown commands, aliases (use `videos`, not `songs`) and locked ones (/help, /buy) are dropped silently, so compare the returned `commands` with what you asked for and report any difference. A command with `available: false` can't be turned on. Free. Needs a write-scope key that belongs to one of the brand's admins or owners.

tools.name: list_bot_skills
tools.description: List a brand bot's owner skills: saved prompts that run as their own "/" commands. Each has `command`, `description`, `prompt` and `state` (on / hidden / off). Also returns `limits` (max skills, prompt and description lengths). Free. The key must belong to one of the brand's admins or owners.

tools.name: save_bot_skill
tools.description: Add or replace (matched by `command`) a skill on a brand bot: a saved prompt that becomes a new "/" command. `/weeklyrecap` runs the prompt in the brand's voice; whatever a member types after the command is the input; the reply is text. Rules: command 3–32 chars (a–z, 0–9, _; starts with a letter) and not a built-in command; description required, ≤80 chars (shown in the "/" menu); prompt 10–2000 chars, written as instructions to the bot; up to 10 skills per bot. A break of a rule comes back as an error message you can show the owner. Each member run uses one piece of their daily branded-content allowance (admins free). Never put keys, passwords or private data in a prompt. Saving refreshes the bot's menu. Free. Needs a write-scope key that belongs to one of the brand's admins or owners.

command.description: The command name, without the slash, e.g. "weeklyrecap".

description.description: Short line for the "/" menu (≤80 chars).

prompt.description: What the bot does when the command runs (10–2000 chars).

tools.name: delete_bot_skill
tools.description: Delete a skill from a brand bot by its command name (a name that doesn't exist is a no-op). Members can no longer run it; the bot's menu refreshes. Free. Needs a write-scope key that belongs to one of the brand's admins or owners.

command.description: The skill's command name, without the slash.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Poll any async job by kind: mp4 (request_mp4), one_minute (create_one_minute), localize (localize_1minute), sitdown (create_sitdown / create_phone_demo / create_best_of / create_ridiculous / create_news), demo_pack (create_demo_pack). Free. Status is rendering (localize adds step + progress), done (with mp4Url or pageUrl and the next steps) or failed (credit refunded). A done sitdown job carries `followUp`: pass its jobId to create_followup to make another post from the same script. Poll every ~20–30s.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Credits and $0.01 face value this key spent. period day (default), week, or month. By tool and format; MP4 broken out. scope=all is operator-only. Free. Forward-only.

period.description: UTC day, rolling week, or month.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show this API key's remaining credits (-1 = unlimited), usage and pricing path (byok = $0.01 per call, list = each tool's list credits).
